ValidationRule.description: Exactly one parent. Both blank is a tag against nobody; both set is two identities on one row, and the Attendee_* formulas would silently prefer the Contact. Equality of the two ISBLANKs is true in precisely those two cases. Note: if a SetNull delete cascade re-fires this rule, deleting a tagged person will fail — see Open Question 14.
ValidationRule.errorMessage: An event history row must point at either a Contact or a Lead — not both, and not neither.
